tools.name: pretix_list_organizers
tools.description: List the organizer accounts this API token can access (slug, name, public URL). A team token sees its own organizer. GET /organizers/.

tools.name: pretix_get_organizer
tools.description: One organizer account: slug, name, public URL. GET /organizers/{organizer}/.

tools.name: pretix_list_events
tools.description: List the events of an organizer (name, slug, dates, live/test mode, currency, location, whether it is an event series). Filter by search text, live state or date. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/.

tools.name: pretix_get_event
tools.description: One event in full: name, dates, location, currency, live/test mode, presale window, meta data, enabled plugins. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/.

tools.name: pretix_list_subevents
tools.description: List the dates (sub-events) of an event series, for one event or across all series of the organizer. Each has id, name, dates, location, presale window and price overrides. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/subevents/ or /organizers/{organizer}/subevents/.

tools.name: pretix_get_subevent
tools.description: One date (sub-event) of an event series. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/subevents/{id}/.

tools.name: pretix_list_items
tools.description: List the products (ticket types, merchandise) of an event with id, name, default price, tax, active flag, category and variations. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/items/.

tools.name: pretix_get_item
tools.description: One product with its variations, add-ons and bundles. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/items/{id}/.

tools.name: pretix_list_quotas
tools.description: List the quotas (capacity pools) of an event: size, the products they cover, closed state and, with with_availability, how many are still available. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/quotas/.

tools.name: pretix_get_quota_availability
tools.description: How much of a quota is left: available, available_number, total_size and what is using it (pending and paid orders, cart positions, blocking vouchers, waiting list). Values can lag slightly. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/quotas/{id}/availability/.

tools.name: pretix_list_orders
tools.description: List orders of one event, or of all events of the organizer when no event is given: code, status, email, total, dates, positions, payments, invoice address. Contains customer personal data. Order secrets, order links and payment details are removed. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/orders/

tools.name: pretix_get_order
tools.description: One order by its code (e.g. ABC12): status, customer email and phone, total, positions (tickets), fees, payments, refunds as recorded, invoice address, check-in flags. Contains customer personal data. Secrets, order link and payment details are removed. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/ord

tools.name: pretix_list_order_positions
tools.description: List the individual tickets (order positions) of one event, or of all events of the organizer when no event is given: attendee name and email, product, variation, price, order code, check-ins, answers. Contains attendee personal data. Ticket secrets are removed. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{e

tools.name: pretix_list_checkin_lists
tools.description: List the check-in lists of an event (id, name, the products they admit, event series date, rule settings). Use the list id for check-in status, attendee lists and check-in. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/checkinlists/.

tools.name: pretix_get_checkin_list_status
tools.description: Live check-in numbers of a check-in list: how many tickets exist, how many are checked in, how many are inside now, broken down per product and variation. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/checkinlists/{id}/status/.

tools.name: pretix_list_checkin_list_positions
tools.description: The attendee list of a check-in list: tickets with attendee name, product, order code, check-in history and whether the ticket needs attention. Contains attendee personal data. Ticket secrets are removed; check in by position id. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/checkinlists/{id}/positions

tools.name: pretix_list_waiting_list
tools.description: List the waiting list entries of an event: who waits for which product, since when, and whether a voucher was already sent. Contains personal data (name, email, phone). Read-only: no voucher is sent. GET /organizers/{organizer}/events/{event}/waitinglistentries/.

tools.name: pretix_checkin_position
tools.description: WRITE: check one ticket in (or out) on a check-in list. Records a real check-in in pretix and cannot be undone from here. Identify the ticket by position_id (from pretix_list_checkin_list_positions) or by ticket_secret (the scanned QR code content). pretix applies its own rules: the call is refused

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pretix_list_organizers, pretix_get_organizer, pretix_list_items, pretix_list_orders, pretix_get_order, pretix_list_order_positions, pretix_get_checkin_list_status, pretix_list_checkin_list_positions, pretix_list_waiting_list, pretix_checkin_position · Private data: pretix_list_organizers, pretix_list_orders, pretix_get_order, pretix_list_order_positions, pretix_list_checkin_list_positions, pretix_checkin_position · Public sink: pretix_list_orders, pretix_get_order, pretix_list_order_positions, pretix_list_waiting_list, pretix_checkin_position.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pretix_list_organizers, pretix_get_organizer, pretix_list_items, pretix_list_orders, pretix_get_order, pretix_list_order_positions, pretix_get_checkin_list_status, pretix_list_checkin_list_positions, pretix_list_waiting_list, pretix_checkin_position · Private data: pretix_list_organizers, pretix_list_orders, pretix_get_order, pretix_list_order_positions, pretix_list_checkin_list_positions, pretix_checkin_position · Public sink: pretix_list_orders, pretix_get_order, pretix_list_order_positions, pretix_list_waiting_list, pretix_checkin_position

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
